headlines: Steady growth: agentic orders grew 24% month over month from August to September (48% including Instinct and Grok).
Then Meta launched Muse: we first detected it on Sep 21, and agentic orders were up 229% month over month that week.
Scraper agents took over: 1% of agentic orders at the beginning of August, 65% last week.
Real baskets: the average agentic order was $223.

insight.text:
In its first week of detection, Muse accounted for more than half of agentic orders.
Since Muse arrived, OpenAI's daily orders are up 16% week over week.

Muse's growth has been additive, not at the expense of other agents.
All agentic orders are now 5.3× their early August level.

Scraper agents went from 1% of agentic orders at the beginning of August to 65% last week.
They can shop anywhere, while protocol agents only reach stores that have integrated them.

Throughout August, OpenAI placed 82% to 93% of agentic orders every week.
Muse bought at 74% of stores that received any agentic order; ChatGPT Agent at 45%, nearly double OpenAI’s protocol.

The average agentic order was $223. Google spends 57% below average, as it only supports single-item checkout.
Purchases between $50 and $200 are the most common for all agents.

Agentic orders are heavily concentrated in North America.
ChatGPT Agent has the most global footprint, with nearly a quarter of its orders outside the US.
